The Beppy Hollow Tampon® is an innovative product that offers a healthier, more durable and safer alternative to traditional disposable tampons.

Using the Beppy Hollow Tampon® is easy and comfortable. Gently fold the tampon sideways and insert it into your vagina in the heart shape. Thanks to its clever design and soft texture, you barely feel the tampon once it’s in the right place. It catches your period without you even noticing it.

Ahelyett, hogy a kelyhet egy edényben forralná a tűzhelyen, ez a praktikus eszköz biztonságosabb és gyorsabb megoldást kínál. Bár a Beppy menstruációs kelyhet kézzel is megtisztíthatja a Natural Cup Soap szappannal, a Steam + Sterilizer ideális azok számára, akik kényelmet és hatékonyságot keresnek. A készülék gőzzel működik, és akár 99,9%-ban eltávolítja a káros baktériumokat, gombákat és vírusokat. Ez azt jelenti, hogy a menstruációs kelyhe nemcsak tiszta lesz, hanem teljesen mentes a használat során felhalmozódott mikrobáktól is.

Használata mindössze 3 lépésben:

1. Töltsön vizet a Beppy Steamer belsejében található tartályba, amíg az meg nem telik.

2. Helyezze be a menstruációs kelyhet.

3. Nyomja meg a gombot, és várj 6-8 percet.

Figyelem: a ciklus befejezése után ne érintse meg a fedél tetejét, mert forró lehet.

A Beppy gőzsterilizáló automatikusan leáll, amikor a víz elpárolog. Várjon, amíg a sterilizáló teljesen kihűl, mielőtt eltávolítanád a fedelet.

If you use a menstrual cup, you know how important it is to clean it properly. Not using a menstrual cup yet, but considering using one? Then it’s good to know that you should always clean a cup thoroughly so that you can use it hygienically without risk to your health. A menstrual cup sterilizer is a device that helps you clean your cup quickly, safely and effectively. With the Beppy Sterilizer, you sterilize your menstrual cup at the touch of a button. Boiling water and steam can eliminate up to 99.9% of bacteria, fungi and viruses. The Beppy Steam + Sterilizer is a smart and innovative device specially designed to sterilize your menstrual cup easily and effectively. Instead of boiling out your cup in a pan on the stove, this handy device offers a safer and faster solution. Although you can also manually clean your Beppy menstrual cup with our Natural Cup Soap, the Steam + Sterilizer is ideal for those seeking convenience and efficiency.

The device works with steam and removes up to 99.9% of harmful bacteria, fungi and viruses. This means your menstrual cup is not only clean, but also completely free of microbes that may accumulate during use.

Disinfect your cup in just 3 steps!

1. Add water until the hole/circle inside the Beppy Steamer is full.

2. Place your menstrual cup inside.

3. Press the button and wait 6-8 minutes.

Caution: when the cycle is complete, do not touch the top of the lid, as it may be hot.

The Beppy Steam Steriliser will automatically stop sterilising when the water has evaporated. Wait until the Steriliser has cooled down completely before removing the lid.
